answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to bonded collateral and correlating equivocation across identities: when k coordinated agents sign conflicting histories, penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss in the controlling escrow, with asymmetric depreciation. A sable swarm cannot cheaply ride the tide or hide in the tundra; splitting keys increases, rather than dilutes, collective risk.
